_comment: Server workspace manifest. Installed via npm workspaces from the pos/ root (single root package-lock.json). Contains every package required by server/*.cjs code so the server can also be deployed standalone (npm install --workspace server or npm install inside server/). Version conflicts with the historical root manifest were reconciled to the higher semver range (@google/genai ^1.38.0, pg ^8.17.1). Frontend/shared dependencies live in the root package.json.
name: server
